name: devflow
description: An Issue-driven development loop for Claude Code and Codex: one lifecycle skill, devflow, resumes from Issues, delegates reads and checks, and leaves checking to review and CI in repositories with a .devflow.json. Also ships four independent skills the loop does not call: decision-interview, write-prompts, audit-prompts and agent-instruction-design.

interface.longDescription: devflow resumes Issue-tracked work from the Issue's state and checkpoints in repositories with a .devflow.json. One lifecycle skill, devflow, takes every stage from starting work through review, PR and merge to branch cleanup (discover, start, design, plan, build, verify, review, ship, cleanup, learn), reads that stage's reference, and delegates reads and checks to fresh-context agents; lifecycle hooks inject the resume card, continue autonomous work within task limits, and release sessions when they end. Four independent skills ship alongside and work in any repository without the loop: decision-interview, write-prompts, audit-prompts and agent-instruction-design.
